title: Replace text
summary: A search and replace over a file, with strstr, printing the pieces as you go.
hints: `strstr(p, old)` finds the next occurrence at or after `p`. Print what is before it with `fwrite(p, 1, hit - p, stdout)`, then `new`, and continue from `hit + strlen(old)`.
When there are no more occurrences in the line print the rest with `fputs(p, stdout)`: you never need a buffer for the result.
